summary.text: Chris Erwin is serving his eighth term in the Georgia House of Representatives, representing District 32, and chairs the House Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Before entering elected office, Erwin retired after 10 years as superintendent of the Banks County School System and previously served as a school administrator in Carroll and Henry counties.
Erwin earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Georgia and advanced degrees from Georgia State University and the University of West Georgia.
